title: Health endpoints for an appointment scheduling API
name: Appointment API health endpoints

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this service separates its liveness and readiness signals? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
During startup, before the CREATE TABLE step finishes, what does /health/ready return?
choices: 200 'ready' if Postgres and the EHR gateway respond
404 because the router is not mounted yet

questions.prompt: The EHR gateway returns HTTP 500 while Postgres is healthy. What does /health/ready report?
choices: 503 'not_ready' with ehr_gateway ok: false and the error message
200 with a warning in the checks array

questions.prompt: After SIGTERM, what is the sequence of events?
choices: Readiness returns 503 'draining' right away; after 10 seconds the HTTP server stops accepting connections, then the pool is closed and the process exits
The pool closes first, then readiness starts failing
The server closes immediately, and readiness keeps returning 200 for 10 seconds
